name: c-bubble-1
title: Support thread with sender alignment
label: Sender Alignment
description: A two sided billing thread where align and variant carry the sender.

guidance.bestFor: A Card with an avatar and name header over a thread mapped from data, each turn announcing its sender to screen readers
agentNotes: Replace `thread` with your messages, and the hardcoded Lena in the screen reader prefix with the real sender name

whenNotToUse.when: Several lines in a row from one person that should read as one turn

name: c-bubble-2
title: Bubble variants in a release thread
label: All Variants
description: All seven variants doing the job each one is for, in one deploy thread.

guidance.bestFor: One turn per variant, from a secondary status update and a destructive failure notice to the full width ghost answer
agentNotes: Replace `turns` with your messages; without its as const assertion the `variant` and `align` strings widen and fail the Bubble prop types

whenNotToUse.when: An assistant answer laid out with a heading, a list and inline code

name: c-bubble-3
title: Grouped consecutive messages
label: Grouped Messages
description: Consecutive turns from one sender collapse into a single BubbleGroup.

guidance.bestFor: Sender entries holding an array of lines, a wider thread gap than group gap, and a delivered time under the last turn
agentNotes: Map your messages into `handoff` entries, each holding one turn's consecutive lines in its `lines` array
Each `Bubble` is keyed by its `line` text, so give lines ids when one entry can repeat a line

whenNotToUse.when: A run of turns from one sender shown under a single avatar

name: c-bubble-4
title: Message reactions and a reaction button
label: Reactions
description: A static emoji row, a pressable reaction with a count, and a top anchored row.

guidance.bestFor: Emoji pills hanging off the bubble edge on a Card, static rows labeled as one image and a single aria-pressed toggle
agentNotes: `reacted` is local state and `cheers` derives 3 or 4 from it; wire the toggle to your stored reaction count and save call
Keep the thread gap near `gap-8`, since `BubbleReactions` sits 3/4 of its height outside the bubble and would cover the next turn
Keep the thread on a `Card`: the reactions ring is drawn in the card color and reads as a halo on the page background in dark mode

name: c-bubble-5
title: Long reply with show more
label: Show More
description: A long assistant answer folds to its first paragraph behind a Collapsible.

guidance.bestFor: A lead paragraph kept out of the panel so nothing repeats, with a link Button trigger whose chevron turns on open
agentNotes: Split your answer into `lead` and `rest`; only `rest` renders inside `CollapsibleContent`
Keep `open` controlled, since the chevron rotates from `data-open` on its own span rather than from the trigger state

whenNotToUse.when: An answer that should show in full, laid out as a short document

name: c-bubble-6
title: Quick reply bubbles and an action row
label: Quick Replies
description: Tinted bubbles that are real buttons and a link, plus an action row after the pick.

guidance.bestFor: Choices that swap for the echoed pick and a reply written for that option, with one choice leaving as a link
agentNotes: Replace `options` with your choices; each needs its own `reply`, or an `href` to render as a link rather than a button
The Check addresses and Notify the owner `Button` controls have no handler, so wire them to your next steps
The reply bubble lifts the 80% width cap with `max-w-full`; keep it on any `Bubble` that holds a row of controls

whenNotToUse.when: Copy, regenerate or rating controls set under a reply rather than inside it

name: c-bubble-7
title: Assistant answer with formatted content
label: Formatted Answer
description: A ghost bubble carrying a heading, a list, emphasis and inline code.

guidance.bestFor: A wide column where the answer spans the row as real elements, with no markdown parser and no raw HTML
agentNotes: The answer is hardcoded JSX inside `BubbleContent`; map model output onto the same elements, or a markdown renderer that never sets raw HTML

whenNotToUse.when: A long answer that should fold to its first paragraph until asked
